Grant's Lounge - The Original Home of Southern Rock

Grant's Lounge has been a legendary staple on the Macon music scene since opening on February 16 1971. Deemed The Original Home of Southern Rock this historic venue gave musical starts to giants including the Allman Brothers Tom Petty Eric Clapton The Marshall Tucker Band Wet Willie and countless others who shaped the sound of American rock and soul music.

Sunday Night Jam Sessions

The most famous regular event is the legendary Sunday Night Jam hosted by Johnny Hollingsworth Jr. This long-running session brings together accomplished musicians local talent and traveling performers in spontaneous collaborative jam sessions. Musicians from all backgrounds and skill levels are welcomed to join creating magical moments when strangers create something special right on stage.

Music Programming

Beyond Sunday jam sessions Grant's hosts live music throughout the week featuring established local and regional acts. The venue's programming blends R&B Rock & Roll Blues Bluegrass and Country music reflecting the diverse roots of American music that shaped Macon's legendary heritage.

Historic Significance

Grant's Lounge is more than a music venue - it is a living museum of American rock and soul history. The back wall displays autographed photos and memorabilia from legendary performances. Musicians from around the country travel to Macon specifically to play at Grant's acknowledging its historic importance and welcoming creative spirit.

Atmosphere

The venue maintains a raw authentic dive bar atmosphere with a genuine welcome for all who enter. The famous welcome-all vibe makes Grant's a refuge for music lovers from all walks of life. The intimate stage setting allows audiences to experience live music in an up-close personal way rare in modern venues.
